results.description: Lower chassis frame constructed from technic bricks, plates, axles, and bushings.
Central chassis frame built from long Technic beams joined by axles, pin connectors, and an angle connector.
Central chassis frame using a large Technic open-center brick held together with friction pins.
The front chassis frame of red technic beams, plates, pins, and a central black reinforcement beam.
